topic.name: search-lessons-learned
topic.description: Queries the LessonsLearned list/library and returns tagged results filtered by capability, asset type, project, and keywords. Preserves the AS2885 (transmission) vs AS4645 (distribution) distinction via AssetType on every result. Tenant-neutral declarative design.

slots.name: keywords
slots.prompt: What topic should I search lessons learned for?

slots.name: assetType
slots.prompt: Transmission or distribution? (optional filter; keeps AS2885 and AS4645 distinct)

rules: Return only records matching the supplied filters; if no filters supplied, return keyword matches.
This is a records search, not a grounded engineering claim, so no clause content is produced here.
AssetType is returned on every result to preserve the Transmission (AS 2885) vs Distribution (AS/NZS 4645) distinction.

output.emptyResultBehaviour: State plainly that no matching lessons were found; do not fabricate a lesson. Suggest broadening the filters or raising a technical query.
